notes: TODO(ml-team): template for a calibration fitted to real data. Copy it to a new file (for example real.v1.json), give it a new `version`, replace every null with a number, and point CALIBRATION_FILE at the copy. While any number below is null the engine treats the file as incomplete and returns an indeterminate result for every scan. Each fuzzy set is a trapezoid [a, b, c, d] with a <= b <= c <= d: zero below a, one between b and c, zero above d. The `unit` strings are the units the derivation code produces and the engine compares against, so change them only together with app/services/biomarker_derivation.py.

hippocampal_volume.description: Bilateral hippocampal volume divided by intracranial volume, in per-mille of ICV. Atrophy here is one of the earliest structural markers of AD-related neurodegeneration.
hippocampal_volume.todo: TODO(ml-team): breakpoints, normal_range and display_range in per-mille of ICV.

ventricle_brain_ratio.description: Lateral plus inferior lateral ventricle volume divided by brain segmentation volume, as a unitless ratio. Enlargement is a proxy for global tissue loss (ex-vacuo dilation).
ventricle_brain_ratio.todo: TODO(ml-team): breakpoints, normal_range and display_range as a ratio (0.04, not 4).

cortical_thickness.description: Mean FreeSurfer cortical thickness over the configured AD-signature regions, both hemispheres, in millimetres. Thinning tracks cumulative neuronal loss.
cortical_thickness.todo: TODO(ml-team): breakpoints, normal_range and display_range in mm.
